explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 61 named tracks, release cuts, current reviews and catalogue references across Juno's live September 2026 techno window, official/label Bandcamp pages, current digital listings and newly recirculated Trelik, PAL SL and Smaul catalogue material. Written metadata and attributed descriptions only; no audio audition.
sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASE WINDOW: Juno's live September 2026 techno page supplied G.rush, Vinicius Honorio, Lenson and Unique Reason releases with exact tracklists and differentiated track descriptions. https://www.juno.co.uk/techno/this-week/

ADJACENT / EMERGING WINDOW: Memoria's Thessaloniki producer G.rush, Mord's Brazil/London/Berlin collaboration field and Rotterdam's Tar Hallow supplied fixed-grid, murky, bass-led, scatterbrained and filtered propositions without treating one genre room as mandatory. https://memoriarecords.bandcamp.com/ ; https://thtarhallow.bandcamp.com/

OVERLOOKED / NEWLY CONTEXTUALIZED WINDOW: the 2026 Acid Pauli, Baby Ford and Soul Capsule reissue/repress cycle supplied exact older forms newly in circulation. https://www.juno.co.uk/products/acid-pauli-gwar-is-not-the-answer-vinyl/1170462-01/ ; https://www.easternblocrecords.com/products/baby-ford-bford-14-reissue ; https://ra.co/reviews/12344
exclusions: Recent Runs 194–202 source fields, all prior ranked leads and alternates, canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits and existing global utility identities were excluded.

The five-run repetition check avoided all boundaries planned in Runs 197, 198, 201 and 202, except Tender Is The Night → Egue into hs was reopened for Firgot because its documented fixed-grid machine-pressure proposition directly tests whether the newly added two-track suspension/re-entry passage can support an intermediate articulation; this is the only repeated current boundary and its reason is candidate-specific.

Top slots prioritize exact digital availability plus differentiated form evidence after two recent zero-resolution runs. This is an information-gain response to resolver identity loss, not a role, artist, texture or platform quota.
Many current listings supplied only release-level straight techno descriptions; these were inspected but not promoted where individual behavior or a plausible journey consequence was absent.

The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer internal order and both listener-protected handoffs remain untouched. No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
